steps.name: probe-and-safe-rules
ac: cd apps/web && pnpm exec biome lint --only=a11y/noSvgWithoutTitle --only=a11y/useButtonType --only=a11y/noRedundantRoles src/features/backtest
cd apps/web && pnpm exec vitest run src/features/backtest

steps.name: template-and-complexity
ac: cd apps/web && pnpm exec biome lint --only=style/useTemplate --only=complexity/noUselessSwitchCase --only=complexity/noUselessFragments --only=complexity/useOptionalChain --only=complexity/useLiteralKeys src/features/backtest
cd apps/web && pnpm exec vitest run src/features/backtest

steps.name: aria-and-semantics
ac: cd apps/web && pnpm exec biome lint --only=a11y/useSemanticElements --only=a11y/useAriaPropsSupportedByRole --only=a11y/noNoninteractiveTabindex --only=a11y/useKeyWithClickEvents src/features/backtest
cd apps/web && pnpm exec vitest run src/features/backtest

steps.name: array-index-key
ac: cd apps/web && pnpm exec biome lint --only=a11y/noSvgWithoutTitle --only=a11y/useButtonType --only=a11y/noRedundantRoles --only=style/useTemplate --only=complexity/noUselessSwitchCase --only=complexity/noUselessFragments --only=complexity/useOptionalChain --only=complexity/useLiteralKeys --only=a11y/useSemanticElements --only=a11y/useAriaPropsSupportedByRole --only=a11y/noNoninteractiveTabindex --only=a11y/useKeyWithClickEvents --only=suspicious/noArrayIndexKey --only=suspicious/noConsole src/features/backtest
cd apps/web && pnpm exec vitest run src/features/backtest
cd apps/web && pnpm exec vitest run
cd apps/web && pnpm exec biome check .
